title: Login Methods
description: Configure how admins and regular users sign in to the panel and portal — any combination can be enabled at once.

internal.title: Local password
internal.disabledWarning: Local sign-in is off — every panel password stops working. If LDAP/OIDC ever breaks, use the emergency account (EMERGENCY_ADMIN_USERNAME/EMERGENCY_ADMIN_PASSWORD panel env vars) — it works even while local sign-in is disabled.
internal.emergencyHint: Break-glass access: if you turn password sign-in off and LDAP/OIDC then stops working, set EMERGENCY_ADMIN_USERNAME and EMERGENCY_ADMIN_PASSWORD in the panel's environment (docker-compose/.env) and restart the container. This account works regardless of the toggle above. Unset the vars and restart again to close the hole.

skipTlsVerify.label: Skip TLS certificate verification
skipTlsVerify.tip: Only enable for testing or self-signed certs on a trusted network -- otherwise the connection is exposed to server spoofing.

bindPassword.label: Bind account password
bindPassword.setPlaceholder: set -- leave blank to keep it

userFilter.label: User search filter
userFilter.tip: %s is replaced with the entered username (escaped automatically). AD typically uses (sAMAccountName=%s), generic LDAP (uid=%s).

groupBaseDn.label: Group base DN (optional)
groupBaseDn.tip: Only used when the user entry has no memberOf attribute -- the panel then searches for groups separately (member=DN or memberUid=username).

oidc.title: OIDC (Keycloak, Authentik, Azure AD, Google Workspace, etc.)

issuerUrl.label: Issuer URL
issuerUrl.tip: The provider's base address -- the panel discovers the rest of its endpoints via /.well-known/openid-configuration.

clientSecret.label: Client Secret
clientSecret.setPlaceholder: set -- leave blank to keep it

redirectBaseUrl.label: Panel's public base URL
redirectBaseUrl.tip: The public address the panel is reachable at, e.g. https://vpn.example.com -- used to build the redirect URI you need to register with your IdP.

oidc.callbackHint: Register this redirect URI with your IdP:

usernameClaim.label: Username claim
usernameClaim.tip: The ID token claim the login is taken from. Defaults to preferred_username.

groupsClaim.label: Groups claim
groupsClaim.tip: The claim carrying group membership -- name varies by provider (groups, roles, etc). If missing from the ID token, the panel also checks the userinfo endpoint.

groupRules.title: Groups → roles
groupRules.description: An account's role comes from its group membership. If a group matches neither list, sign-in is denied.
